Client statement: “I like your idea of adding more vegetables to the meals I already make. That

vegetables to dishes

Client statement: “I think I could fit in walks on the weekends, possibly one on Saturday and 
one on Sunday.”
“You’re walking 2 days 
a week, which is a great 
start, but you want to aim 
for 5 days a week. Once 
you’re exercising more 
often, you’ll really start to 
notice a difference.”
Practitioner sets 
client’s goal without 
asking client first.
“Walking 2 days a week 
is a great start.”
